homeFaqs.title: faqs
homeFaqs.description: In this section, you'll find answers to the most common questions about our products and services.
homeFaqs.questionOne: Do you work on a custom basis based on a client's idea or concept?
homeFaqs.answerOne: Yes, all our projects are customized. We work closely with the client to transform their ideas into unique and functional designs.
homeFaqs.questionTwo: What is the work process from initial contact to final delivery?
homeFaqs.answerTwo: We begin with a meeting to understand your needs, then we develop a visual and technical proposal, and after approval, we move on to production and assembly.
homeFaqs.questionThree: How far in advance should I place my order?
homeFaqs.answerThree: In case of an emergency, contact us and we'll get back to you. We recommend contacting us at least 1 to 3 months in advance, depending on the size of the project.
homeFaqs.questionFour: Do you offer transportation and set-up for stage sets or floats?
homeFaqs.answerFour: Yes, we offer a full service, including transportation and set-up at the event or performance venue.
homeFaqs.questionFive: Do you carry out work nationwide?
homeFaqs.answerFive: We carry out work nationally and internationally.
homeFaqs.questionSix: How do I request a quote?
homeFaqs.answerSix: You can contact us through the form on our website, by email, or by phone. Tell us your idea, dates, and location of the event, and we'll send you a customized proposal.
